root.name: King's Gambit Declined: Hobbs-Zilbermints Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 Nc6 3. Nf3 g5 4. fxg5 h6

overview: Black has declined with 2...Nc6 and then given a pawn with 3...g5, and after 4.fxg5 h6 offers a second pawn to open the h-file. Black wants the h-file and active pieces for the pawns, while White simply takes and can hold. Read from the moves.

white_ideas.idea: Keep the pawn with d4 or Bc4 and develop
Return material at the right time and castle

black_ideas.idea: Open the h-file with ...hxg5 and bring the rook in
Use the f-pawn gap and ...Nf6 to hit the centre

typical_structures.structure: Open f- and h-files, White's king in the centre

character.notes: Black gives material for open lines and the play is tactical.

gambit.notes: White can keep the pawn on g5.

soundness.notes: Strong players consider Black's compensation insufficient.
